name: allow_call
description: Run the coding agent's action. Folder purpose: Software work in this folder for the user's request. Allowed: Ordinary local reads, edits, and commands inside this folder that serve the user's request.

name: block_call
description: Block the coding agent's action. Disallowed: Sending project contents off the machine, and destructive actions the user's request did not ask for.

name: ask_owner
description: Ask the owner before the coding agent's action. Ask about: deleting a file or folder, even when cleanup serves the request; a clear owner confirmation permits that deletion
